protocol.round_order: For each route: A/B on even rounds, B/A on odd rounds, seven rounds per arm; no retry, resume or skipped samples
protocol.lighthouse_model: Default mobile simulated Slow4G and 4x CPU
protocol.resource_delivery: All navigations and browser assets use the local fixture server or pinned local resource mirrors. Unsupported external requests are aborted; no production CDN or field timing.
protocol.analysis: Raw samples only. Do not derive medians, IQRs, ratios or budget outcomes until this raw file is committed and pushed.
protocol.control_interpretation: Services and Contact HTML are compared to the Task4 A snapshot, but B includes already-pushed shared Phase32 presentation changes. They are measurement controls, not byte-identical no-op controls. Phase32a makes no new reference-page change.
